summary: NEW YORK, November 09, 2026--IMAX Corporation (NYSE: IMAX) today announced a monstrous opening for Toho Co., Ltd.’s Godzilla Minus Zero with $21.3 million worldwide — the biggest IMAX global opening ever for a Japanese film. The first Japanese Filmed For IMAX release ever among the more than 80 Japanese films IMAX has presented, IMAX screens delivered a whopping 34% of the global opening of Godzilla Minus Zero on less than 1% of total screens.
